corpus_note: Graphalytics corpora are NAMED GRAPHS, not scale factors — kgs, cit-Patents, wiki-Talk, datagen-*. A run stamps its scale as `ga-<graph>` (see `Rig::scale`): a bare `kgs` set beside an `sf10` would read as a third scale factor of the SNB corpus, and the reporter compares scales as TEXT and refuses a table that spans two. The prefix is what keeps a Graphalytics row from ever being averaged with an SNB one.
protocol_note: Transcribed from the specification and implemented in `src/bin/graphalytics.rs`: THREE repetitions per algorithm-dataset job, ranked on the ARITHMETIC MEAN of Tp; `EVPS = (V + E) / mean(Tp)` and never the mean of per-run EVPS, which flatters the fast run; Tl (load) reported but EXCLUDED from Tp, which is algorithm execution alone; per-scale ceilings S 900s / M 1800s / L 3600s / XL 7200s / 2XL+ 10800s. A repetition that breaches its ceiling marks the whole job `tim` and carries `mean_is_lower_bound`, because a timed-out run otherwise contributes the TIMEOUT DURATION as its metric — a finite and flattering number that makes a mean lower than any honest measurement.
conformance_note: Every kernel must be driven with `graphalytics: true` (`AlgoConfig::graphalytics`, `crates/engram-graph/src/algo/modes.rs`), which gates all five divergences from engram's defaults. Without it the lane validates DEFAULT semantics and proves nothing about conformance.
validation_note: The spec's match is RELATIVE with eps = 1e-4, and where the reference value is ZERO only an exact zero passes. An absolute epsilon is the wrong mode for LCC in particular, whose zero-reference rows — every vertex of degree 0 or 1 — are the most numerous rows in the file. The verdict is computed from COUNTS and never sniffed out of the printed text: an earlier cut searched that text for 'DIFFERS' and reported `0/10` as a PASS.

BFS.title: Breadth-first search
BFS.note: Unreachable vertices carry the spec's sentinel rather than being absent; a missing vertex is a MISMATCH, not a skip.

WCC.title: Weakly connected components
WCC.note: Component IDs are arbitrary labels, so the comparison is a PARTITION equivalence — relabelling must pass and merging two components must fail.

SSSP.title: Single-source shortest paths
SSSP.note: Weighted. The graph's declared weight property is read from the dataset's `.properties`/`params.json`; a run that cannot find one must FAIL rather than quietly fall back to unweighted, which answers a different question.

LCC.title: Local clustering coefficient
LCC.note: Most rows have a ZERO reference (every vertex of degree 0 or 1), so the zero rule carries this kernel. Validated on wiki-Talk: 2,135,249 zero-reference rows, all exact.

CDLP.title: Community detection by label propagation
CDLP.note: Deterministic under the spec's fixed iteration count and tie-break. Its dedup divergence CANNOT surface on an undirected graph, and every competition graph is undirected — so exactness on the DIRECTED wiki-Talk is the first evidence it is closed rather than merely unobservable.
